s: September 2, 2025 - By 2008, the BMW Z4 two-seater convertible in top trim commanded $48,395. Today, that exact car's KBB fair market value is all of $11,248. That leaves an awful lot of space under $30,000 to find the one for you. Even pushing up to 2016, the Bavarian's top trim sDrive35is slides in under the mark with a KBB value of $29,413. Our review found the BMW Z4 M40I sublime, though reaching back a few years snags better bang for the buck. In that price range, BMW buyers can find sub-6 second-to-60 mph times, BMW stability control, 17- or 18-inch tires, leather seating, 10-speaker systems, and other accoutrements of BMW ownership.
